as: He took part in the Pledge of Riḍwān.
He was brave, a skilled archer, beneficent and good.
وكان من الشجعان، ويسبق الفرس عدوا
He was one of the brave, and could outrun a horse.
وكان شجاعا راميا سخيا خيرا فاضلا
He was brave, a skilled archer, generous, good and a man of merit.
إياس, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
The best of our footmen is Salamah ibn al-Akwaʿ.
وكان شجاعا راميا محسنا خيرا فاضلا
He was brave, a skilled archer, beneficent, good and a man of merit.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
The best of our footmen is Salamah ibn al-Akwaʿ.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
خير فرساننا اليوم أبو قتادة وخير رجالتنا سلمة
The best of our horsemen today is Abū Qatādah, and the best of our footmen is Salamah.
يزيد بن أبو عبيد, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
كان سلمة بن الأكوع إذا سئل بوجه الله أفف ويقول: من لم يعط بوجه الله فبماذا يعطى
When asked in God’s name he showed displeasure at the way he was asked but said that if one does not give when asked in God’s name, by what would one give?
